name: DIY grid-tied solar array with seasonal tilt mechanism

mentions.name: DIY grid-tied solar array with seasonal tilt mechanism
mentions.description: A DIY grid-tied residential solar array with inverter and battery storage, currently designing a seasonal tilt mechanism that lifts and lowers five panels at a time (60-degree angle in winter, 35 degrees in spring/summer/fall). The design weighs two linear actuators versus a single hydraulic jack connected to support beams, aiming to raise the entire top edge at once to prevent twisting.
mentions.source_excerpt: DIY grid-tied residential solar+inverter+battery. Trying to design the solar arrays' tilt mechanism now for lifting/lowering 5 panels at a time in winter (60-degree winter angle, 35-degree spring/summer/fall; ~24" difference).
